body: Thinking-enabled vision-language models (VLMs) report ever-higher accuracy on spatial benchmarks, yet final-answer scores cannot reveal whether a correct prediction reflects faithful spatial reasoning or a linguistic shortcut. We introduce SpatialChain, a dataset of 28,350 training and 899 test examples pairing spatially-oriented GQA questions with scene-graph-grounded reasoning chains, retained only when the generated answer matches the symbolic ground truth, and a two-axis evaluation combining objective chain-overlap metrics with a scene-graph-aware LLM judge that scores faithfulness and completeness independently of the final answer. Applied to nine thinking-enabled VLMs, the protocol surfaces three findings invisible to standard accuracy: (i) four of nine models achieve ≥79% VQA accuracy while exhibiting shortcut rates above 39%, i.e., correct answers whose reasoning the judge marks as unfaithful; (ii) chain quality significantly predicts answer correctness for seven of nine models, but the two exceptions (Claude Sonnet 4.6, InternVL3.5-8B) reveal qualitatively distinct failure modes, terse output vs. verbose-decorative reasoning, that benchmark accuracy alone conflates; (iii) SFT on SpatialChain improves Qwen3-VL-8B by +6.2 pp in-domain and reduces its shortcut rate to 22%, while a stylistic specialization effect on external benchmarks motivates replay-augmented training as mitigation. The faithfulness judge is validated against 198 human-annotated items, where judge-human agreement matches human-human agreement, and against a second judge from a different provider, which preserves the model ranking (ρ = 0.88). Data, generation scripts, and evaluation code are released at https://github.com/spatialchain/SpatialChainBenchmark.
summaryZh: 本文推出了SpatialChain基准测试，旨在评估多模态大模型（VLM）在空间推理任务中的真实忠实度。通过引入场景图引导的推理链和双轴评估协议，研究发现许多模型在保持高准确率的同时存在严重的“语言捷径”现象。实验表明，即使是表现优异的模型也可能在推理逻辑上存在缺陷，该基准为提升模型推理的透明度和可靠性提供了关键评估工具。

glossary.explanationZh: 视觉语言模型，能够处理图像与文本输入并生成相关输出的模型。
空间推理，指模型理解物体在空间中位置、关系及几何属性的能力。
忠实度，指模型的推理过程是否与其最终输出逻辑一致，而非仅靠猜测。
语言捷径，指模型通过文本统计规律而非实际视觉推理得出正确答案的现象。
场景图，一种将图像内容结构化为物体及其空间关系的图数据表示。
监督微调，通过标注数据对预训练模型进行针对性训练以提升特定任务表现。
